Chapter 893: Chapter 1: First Arrival in the Immortal Realm (Please Subscribe)

Immortal Realm, Xuantian Immortal Domain.

The Xuantian Immortal Domain is one of thirty-three Immortal Domains, vast and boundless, situated near the Demon Abyss.

Within the Immortal Domain, numerous immortals are engaged in constant battles with the countless demons emerging from the depths of the Demon Abyss.

A streak of Escape Light flashed by in an instant, faintly suffused with the scent of blood, evidently akin to a blood escape method that consumes the Origin Source.

Within the Escape Light was a young man, pale-faced, weak in breath. The young man’s name was Gao Wuyou, who not long ago explored an ancient relic with a close friend.

As a result, he obtained a great opportunity; the relic was left by a Jade Immortal, containing treasures of the level of a Jade Immortal. That friend, in order to monopolize the opportunity, launched a sneak attack and seriously injured Gao Wuyou.

In a desperate struggle, Gao Wuyou barely escaped but was still pursued by his friend.

“Ha ha ha ha, Gao Wuyou, with the poison of the Demon Marrow in you, unless a Golden Immortal takes action, your death is certain. Why bother resisting? Instead of constantly enduring the agony of marrow extraction, why not let your brother save you from this pain…”

“Wu, for mere relics, if you wanted them, you could have just said so. Why resort to such measures?”

“Just said so? Would you have given them to me if I’d simply asked? These are treasures left by a Jade Immortal!”

“Wu, you’ve helped me many times, is there anything between us that can’t be discussed?”

“Forget about it. I only trust myself. Discuss? Too troublesome. Once you’re dead, won’t all the treasures be mine?”

…

Gao Wuyou continued to burn his essence blood, flashes of conversation with ‘Wu’ during the pursuit crossing his mind, which momentarily filled him with despair.

He truly treated Wu as kin, and the path of cultivation is lonely enough; as a mentor, Wu’s status was extraordinary.

Regrettably, for an unclear opportunity left by a Jade Immortal, Wu didn’t hesitate to turn on him with cruel intent.

Although Gao Wuyou was well aware that the path of immortality was fraught with deceit and one must always be wary, he still couldn’t believe that Wu would do such a thing to him.

“So be it.”

“Consider this as repayment for the kindness of these years.”

Gao Wuyou’s consciousness slowly sunk into darkness, with his severe injuries and the poisoning by Demon Marrow, he indeed couldn’t hold on much longer.

He burned his essence blood to flee, merely wanting to understand why Wu would turn against him.

With Gao Wuyou’s strength, he could completely attempt to destroy the Jade Immortal’s opportunity before his death, at least the part that contained the recorded legacy and cultivation methods.

But in the end, Gao Wuyou did not do so. Since Wu wanted the opportunity, he might as well take it.

Just as Gao Wuyou’s will completely plummeted into darkness, a new consciousness quietly awakened.

Gao Wuyou’s expression suddenly became calm, he glanced around the environment with a frown.

Lin Yuan quickly absorbed Gao Wuyou’s memories, understanding the current situation, where his closest brother was hunting him, and he too was resigned to death.

“A Jade Immortal’s opportunity?”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts churned, after absorbing Gao Wuyou’s memories, he naturally understood the level of this opportunity.

The cultivation system of the Immortal Realm, following that of Central Divine Continent, Spirit Realm.

Is divided into —

Qi Refinement, Foundation Establishment, Core Formation, Nascent Soul, Divinity Transformation, Refine Void, Union, Transcendance Tribulation, Mahayana, Golden Immortal, Jade Immortal, Ancestral Master.

Among them, the Transcendance Tribulation Stage corresponds to the Eighth Layer of the Main Universe, Mahayana is the Ninth Layer, Golden Immortal corresponds to the Tenth Layer, Jade Immortal to the Eleventh Layer, and the Ancestral Master is the ultimate Twelfth Layer of the Main Universe.

Of course, these stage correspondences are mere estimates; differences in cultivation systems mean that even within the same level, there can be variations in power, but the overall gap is not significant.

Gao Wuyou was a rogue cultivator of the Xuantian Immortal Domain, at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, while Wu, at the peak of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, had known each other since the Nascent Soul Stage, traveled side by side, and stepped into the Transcendance Tribulation Stage together.

“I am now…”

Lin Yuan’s brow furrowed tightly, sensing the dire state of his current body.

Severe injuries were the least of his concerns; with Lin Yuan’s awakened spirit and will, he could suppress it with a thought, preventing the injuries from worsening.

Based on Lin Yuan’s control over the body, as long as he had time, any injury could be healed; once the Divine Skill’s imprint ‘Blood Resurrection’ was reproduced onto this body, he could completely be termed as having an undying physique.

But what about the poison of Demon Marrow?

The poison of Demon Marrow originated from the unfathomable Demon Abyss, a peculiar poison for cultivators on the Immortal Path, which suppressed mana and soul.

The pain during poisoning was as agonizing as marrow being extracted from bone.

The poison of Demon Marrow that affected Lin Yuan was of the Transcendance Tribulation level, only hoping for a Golden Immortal’s intervention for a cure.

Of course, that’s for a cultivator on the Immortal Path.

Lin Yuan does not fall within this range.

“Let’s see.”

Lin Yuan carefully examined the Demon Marrow poison inside his body.

[Your perception is against the heavens; observing unknown toxins, you rapidly enhance your understanding of this type of poison…]

Lin Yuan prioritized dealing with the Demon Marrow poison because he perceived that this virulent poison could cause irreversible damage to the body and soul.

Although this ‘irreversible’ was not absolute for Lin Yuan, it was still troublesome, so it’s better to resolve it quickly.

…

In the high sky behind Lin Yuan, Wu was rapidly traversing through space, his vast divine consciousness faintly locking onto the fleeing Gao Wuyou.

Wu’s name was ‘Wu Xiangyan’, currently closely following Gao Wuyou.

“The method of blood escape is innately consuming on the Origin Source, plus the poison of Demon Marrow, Gao Wuyou, you can’t hold out for long,” Wu Xiangyan thought to himself coldly.

Indeed, his relationship with Gao Wuyou was profound, but what of that? Could any relationship be more valuable than one’s own path to enlightenment?

After stepping into the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, Wu Xiangyan became increasingly aware that with his own talents, the chances of breaking through to the Mahayana Realm were practically nonexistent.
